about: The held-out lane's record (bench/heldout/manifest.json): append-only, written by .github/workflows/heldout.yml alone. Each entry is one program measured by one run, chained to the entry before it by its sha256 (bench/heldout/lane.mjs); a program's first contact is never replaced, a later measurement is stored beside it as tuned.
